headline: This law makes sure federal workers furloughed during a February 2018 funding lapse get paid back, and approves spending committed during that gap.
what_it_does: It changes the Continuing Appropriations Act, 2018, which funds the government temporarily. It says employees furloughed because of a funding lapse that started around February 9, 2018, will be paid for that time. It also approves certain costs that agencies committed to while funding was not yet in place. Finally, it counts the lapse period as part of the time the continuing funding law covers.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees furloughed during the February 2018 funding lapse
who_it_affects.how: They are entitled to compensation for the days they were sent home without pay.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that made spending commitments during the lapse
who_it_affects.how: Certain obligations they incurred in anticipation of funding are approved after the fact.

when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on February 9, 2018, and applies to the funding lapse that began on or about that date.
